description: `multiverse result <task-id>` refuses rather than guesses in two real-history shapes spec-on-disk-contract.md calls out: a task with no status file at all (ambiguous — still running, or the id never existed), and a task whose status file holds a value TaskStatus doesn't recognize (the live fleet has seen `donedone`/`donedonedone`/`doneblocked` from partial writes — gateway.py must not substring-match or guess at any of those). Both task ids carry an old pre-rename dispatch role name (`observer`), which this command never parses at all.

expect.stderr: task '<ID>' has no status file. A running task has no status file at all, so this absence is ambiguous — it may still be running, or the task id may not exist
task '<ID>' has an unrecognized status ('donedone'); refusing to guess whether it is finished
